# convoy_portal_link_token (Ephemeral Resource)

Issues a fresh, short-lived access token for a portal link that uses the `refresh_token` auth type. The token is never stored in the Terraform plan or state; pass it to write-only arguments or other ephemeral contexts. Requires Terraform 1.10 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "convoy_portal_link" "acme" {
  name      = "Acme portal"
  owner_id  = "customer_acme"
  auth_type = "refresh_token"
}

# A fresh token on every run, never written to plan or state.
ephemeral "convoy_portal_link_token" "acme" {
  portal_link_id = convoy_portal_link.acme.id
}

# Hand it to a write-only argument, e.g. a secret store.
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "acme_portal" {
  secret_id                = "acme/convoy-portal-token"
  secret_string_wo         = ephemeral.convoy_portal_link_token.acme.token
  secret_string_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `portal_link_id` (String) Portal link ID.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `token` (String, Sensitive) The new portal access token.
